info.name: Microsoft GraphRAG - Live
info.description: Real local Microsoft GraphRAG index and real model calls. Start Uvicorn separately. OpenAI usage incurs cost. No keys or mock retrieval are included. Semantic smoke checks are not an accuracy benchmark.

exec: pm.test('Index is ready', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.ready).to.eql(true); pm.expect(r.backend).to.eql('microsoft_graphrag'); pm.expect(r.available_modes).to.have.members(['local','global','drift']); pm.expect(r.counts.entities).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(r.counts.community_reports).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: 2. Retrieve real review evidence with supervisor

exec: pm.test('Evidence comes from Microsoft index', () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.evidence.length).to.be.above(0); r.evidence.forEach(e => { pm.expect(e.source_id).to.match(/^microsoft_graphrag:(text_unit|community_report):/); pm.expect(e.text.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(e.tool).to.match(/^ms_/); }); });

pm.test('Selected citations exist in evidence ledger', () => { const r = pm.response.json(); const known = r.evidence.map(e => e.evidence_id); pm.expect(r.answer_evidence_ids.length).to.be.above(0); r.answer_evidence_ids.forEach(id => { pm.expect(known).to.include(id); pm.expect(r.answer).to.include('[' + id + ']'); }); });

item.name: 3. Reject out-of-scope coding request before retrieval

exec: pm.test('Out-of-scope request is rejected without retrieval', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('rejected'); pm.expect(r.evidence).to.eql([]); pm.expect(r.tool_calls).to.eql(0); });
